at `caca25b`, pointed at the live API (`https://h2o-api-5sxc.onrender.com`).

Scan `gatezo_apk_qr.png`, or open this link on the phone:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanket-dhamke/H2O_SanketPOC/refs/heads/cursor/gatezo-apk-2dd7/dist/GATEZO-preview-v1.0.0-build34.apk
```

## Before you install

This build uses the same debug signature as builds 32 and 33, with a higher
version, so it installs over that test APK. Your society data stays on the server.

If Android says the app is not installed, uninstall the older GATEZO first, then
open the link again. Chrome asks once for permission to install apps.

Phones only: arm64.

## What this build changes

Ask GATEZO no longer shows Hindi or Marathi under the question box. That is the
same for resident, guard, and admin.

Community shortcuts are in the Services & help grid under the notices, not in a
horizontal row at the top. Guards do not see Home services or Buy & Sell there.

Home → Needs your attention includes an approved clubhouse booking and a society
notice. Maintenance has a place to save the mobile number used for payment.
